passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: (UNLESS INDICATED OTHERWISE, DOLLARS IN MILLIONS EXCEPT PER SHARE AMOUNTS) OVERVIEW Company Background In 2025, we were organized into five reportable operating segments: Taste, Food Ingredients, Health & Biosciences, Scent and, until its divestiture in May 2025, Pharma Solutions. Our Taste segment consists of the development and production of a range of flavor compounds and natural taste solutions that are ultimately used by our customers in a diverse variety of products, including savory products (soups, sauces, meat, fish, poultry, snacks, etc.), beverages (juice drinks, carbonated or flavored beverages, spirits, etc.), sweets (bakery products, candy, cereal, chewing gum, etc.), and dairy products (yogurt, ice cream, cheese, etc.). Taste also includes value-added spices and seasoning ingredients for meat, food service, convenience, alternative protein and culinary products. Our Food Ingredients segment consists of a diversified portfolio across natural, artificial and plant-based specialty food ingredients that provide functional properties solutions for food and beverage products, as well as specialty soy and pea protein with value-added formulations, emulsifiers and sweeteners. Natural food protection ingredients consist of natural antioxidants and anti-microbials used for natural food preservation and shelf-life extension for beverages, cosmetic and healthcare products, pet food and feed additives. Food Ingredients also includes savory solutions (such as spices, marinades, and mixtures) and inclusion products (such as products combining flavorings with fruit, vegetables and other natural ingredients). 24 Table of Contents Our Health & Biosciences segment consists of the development and production of an advanced biotechnology-derived portfolio of enzymes, food cultures, probiotics and specialty ingredients for food and non-food applications. Among many other applications, our portfolio includes cultures for use in fermented foods such as yogurt, cheese and fermented beverages, probiotic strains, household detergents, animal feed, ethanol production and brewing. Health & Biosciences is comprised of Health, Food Biosciences, Home & Personal Care, Animal Nutrition and Grain Processing. Our Scent segment creates fragrance compounds and fragrance ingredients that are integral elements in the world’s finest perfumes and best-known household and personal care products. Consumer insights, science and creativity are at the heart of our Scent business, along with our unique portfolio of natural and synthetic ingredients, global footprint, innovative technologies and know-how, and customer intimacy. The Scent segment is comprised of Fragrance Compounds and Fragrance Ingredients. Our former Pharma Solutions segment produced, among other things, a vast portfolio of cellulosics and seaweed-based pharmaceutical excipients, used in prescription and over-the-counter pharmaceuticals and dietary supplements. We completed the divestiture of our Pharma Solutions disposal group, which included certain adjacent businesses, on May 1, 2025 and we divested our nitrocellulose business, which was within our Pharma Solutions segment, on May 9, 2025. 2025 Segment Re

passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: We routinely encounter and address risks in conducting our business. Some of these risks may cause our future results to be different - sometimes materially different – than in the past or than we presently anticipate. Below are some of the risks we have identified that could adversely affect our business. How we react to material future developments, as well as how our competitors and customers react to those developments, could also affect our future results. Risks Related to Our Business and Industry Consumer demand and preferences, as well as regulatory trends may impact demand for our products, which may have a negative effect on our operating results and future growth. Many of our products are ingredients or components in consumer products which are sold to end-users throughout the world. Demand for such consumer products depends on consumer preferences that are driven by a variety of factors, such as the increasing use of weight management pharmaceutical products, increasing health and wellness awareness, greater transparency in product labeling, and changes in global, regional or local economic conditions (such as inflation, unemployment, salaries and wage rates stagnation, low growth rates, and impacts of supply disruptions, climate events, or geopolitical developments). At the same time, increased regulatory requirements, statements or questions around certain of our products, may result in changes in customer orders or delays in developing, manufacturing or marketing of new or existing products. Moreover, given that the timing or volumes in our customers’ orders are generally at our customers’ discretion, customers may cancel, reduce or postpone orders with us on relatively short notice. These and other consumer and regulatory trends may continue to affect the demand for our products and impact our ability to meet certain productivity levels. If we are unable to anticipate or react to these trends in a timely and cost-effective manner, our productivity, results of operations and future growth may be adversely affected. Our business is highly competitive, and if we are unable to compete effectively, our sales and results of operations will suffer. 11 Table of Contents We face intense global competition from multinational and specialized companies across our product offerings, as well as consumer product companies developing their own alternatives. Competitors may have greater resources, proprietary technologies, or benefit from recent industry consolidation, enabling them to respond more effectively to customer or market demands. As we expand into adjacent markets, such as functional foods and specialty fine ingredients, we encounter additional risks, including price sensitivity and lower margins. Our ability to compete depends on, among other things, innovation, product quality, regulatory compliance, pricing, logistical efficiency, digital proficiency, customer service, and intellectual property protection. Failure to invest in growth, scale new concepts, or adapt to technological advancements could erode our competitive position. credit_strengths.text: IFF's Taste, Food Ingredients, Health & Biosciences and Scent segments generate recurring ingredient demand across savory, beverage, dairy and fragrance applications, supporting revenue near eleven billion dollars. Operating cash flow of eight hundred fifty million dollars covers capital spending and dividends, and the divestiture of Pharma Solutions reduced debt materially, demonstrating proactive portfolio and liability management.

The completed tender offers retired roughly two and a half billion dollars of senior notes, cutting total debt from nearly nine billion to just under six billion dollars. This deleveraging, funded by divestiture proceeds, lowers future interest burden and extends the maturity runway, with no significant maturities concentrated in the next twelve months beyond the Euro notes.

key_risks.text: Consumer demand and preferences, regulatory trends, and competition could pressure volumes and margins. Customers may cancel, reduce or postpone orders on short notice, and competitors with greater resources or proprietary technologies could erode IFF's position. These demand and competitive risks are material because operating income is already negative, leaving little cushion to absorb volume or pricing shocks.

The debt note shows a large Euro-denominated note maturing within the next twelve months, alongside commercial paper and bank overdrafts. Refinancing this maturity in a higher-rate environment could raise interest costs, and the revolving facility remains a backstop. The disclosed maturity profile concentrates near-term repayment risk despite the recent tender offers.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Operating income is negative, so interest coverage is deeply negative and well below the sector median. EBITDA proxy of five hundred eighty million dollars against gross interest expense of two hundred twenty-nine million dollars provides only modest cushion. Free cash flow to debt is in the low single digits, far below the sector median, indicating weak cash-based debt servicing capacity.

Free cash flow of two hundred fifty-six million dollars is insufficient to cover dividends of four hundred nine million dollars and buybacks of thirty-eight million dollars, meaning shareholder returns absorb more than free cash flow. This shortfall must be funded from balance sheet cash or incremental borrowings, pressuring liquidity and leverage unless earnings recover.

overall_credit_view.text: IFF is highly leveraged, with net leverage near nine times, far above the sector median, and an indicative financial risk profile of Highly leveraged. The Altman Z double prime score sits in the Grey zone. Deleveraging from divestiture proceeds is positive, but weak operating profitability and negative coverage keep credit quality under pressure.

Our forward view is that leverage could improve if EBITDA rises by roughly eight hundred sixty million dollars to reach the upgrade threshold, but a downgrade risk remains if cash flow declines. Liquidity is adequate with a current ratio above one, yet refinancing the near-term Euro notes and funding shareholder returns will test cash generation. We would monitor EBITDA recovery and debt reduction as key rating drivers.

credit_strengths.text: IFF 的 Taste、Food Ingredients、Health & Biosciences 及 Scent 分部在鹹味、飲品、乳製品及香精應用中產生經常性原料需求，支持收入接近一百一十億美元。營運現金流八億五千萬美元足以覆蓋資本開支及股息，而出售 Pharma Solutions 大幅減少債務，展現積極的投資組合及負債管理。
已完成的收購要約註銷約二十五億美元優先票據，將總債務從近九十億美元降至略低於六十億美元。此去槓桿由出售所得資金支持，降低未來利息負擔並延長到期期限，除歐元票據外，未來十二個月並無重大到期集中。

key_risks.text: 消費者需求及偏好、監管趨勢及競爭可能對銷量及利潤率構成壓力。客戶可能短期內取消、減少或推遲訂單，而擁有更多資源或專有技術的競爭對手可能削弱 IFF 的地位。這些需求及競爭風險屬重大，因營運收入已為負數，吸納銷量或定價衝擊的緩衝有限。
債務附註顯示一筆大額歐元計價票據將於未來十二個月內到期，另有商業票據及銀行透支。在利率較高環境下為此到期再融資可能提高利息成本，而循環信貸額度仍為後備。儘管近期收購要約，披露的到期結構仍集中短期還款風險。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 營運收入為負數，故利息覆蓋率嚴重為負，遠低於行業中位數。EBITDA 代理值五億八千萬美元對總利息支出二億二千九百萬美元僅提供有限緩衝。自由現金流對債務比率處於低單位數，遠低於行業中位數，顯示現金基礎的債務償付能力疲弱。
自由現金流二億五千六百萬美元不足以覆蓋股息四億零九百萬美元及回購三千八百萬美元，意味股東回報吸收超過自由現金流。此缺口須以資產負債表現金或增量借款填補，對流動性及槓桿構成壓力，除非盈利復甦。

overall_credit_view.text: IFF 槓桿高企，淨槓桿接近九倍，遠高於行業中位數，指示性財務風險狀況為高度槓桿。Altman Z 雙素分數處於灰色區域。出售所得去槓桿屬正面，但營運盈利能力疲弱及覆蓋率為負令信貸質量受壓。
我們的前瞻觀點是，若 EBITDA 上升約八億六千萬美元以達到升級門檻，槓桿可能改善，但若現金流下降，降級風險仍然存在。流動性充足，流動比率高於一，但為短期歐元票據再融資及為股東回報提供資金將考驗現金生成。我們將監察 EBITDA 復甦及債務減少作為關鍵評級驅動因素。
